sequential_dependency.intermediate: The transformed query panel produced by Step A. Its occupied coordinates depend jointly on the A-to-B transform and the private query geometry.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Infer the unique non-identity D4 transform mapping panel A to panel B, then apply that transform to query panel Q.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Intersect the original query panel Q with the transformed-query intermediate; output color 9 exactly where both are nonzero and 0 elsewhere.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step B needs the coordinates of transformed Q. Skipping A and substituting Q itself turns the operation into Q intersect Q, painting every query foreground cell 9 and changing the protected-Racket output.
